# Kyle White

> Kyle White is a venture investor and accelerator builder from Youngstown, Ohio. He built Cointelegraph's accelerator (60 investments across 4 cohorts, $125M in follow-on funding, 70 VC partners, 50 mentors, 300 partners) and is a Techstars All-Star Mentor (2024).

Venture capital, startup accelerators, Web3, blockchain, real-estate tokenization, digital assets, family offices.
